title: Docs: the release site tests failed at three cuts in a row, and nothing runs them before the tag

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent

body:
## The maintainer's words

2026-11-26: "Issue; P1; Docs bug; actions/runs/45742430230/job/139654523067 this is the third time now the docs/sites pipeline failed."

## What happens

The `site` job of `release.yml` fails at the step "Site tests" after the tag. The `pages` job then does not deploy the documentation. A person must repair the site on a `site/vX.Y.0` branch and deploy it again.

| Cut | Failed | Repair |
|---|---|---|
| v0.25.0 | #3271 | site-only branch |
| v0.26.0 | #3763 | #3768, `site/v0.26.0` |
| v0.27.0 | run 45742430230, job 139654523067 (#4106) | #4109, `site/v0.27.0` |

The v0.27.0 failures (104 tests, 4 failures and 2 errors):
- Two tutorial tests read a UI file that does not exist now.
- The icons `op-rotary-flow.png` and `tool-form-mill.png` were not in `site/static/icons/`.
- The operation reference had no section for `RotaryFlow`.

The site of v0.27.0 is repaired and deployed. This issue is about the cause.

## Cause

`python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` runs in `.github/workflows/release.yml` only. No gate tier and no workflow on `main` runs it. A PR that adds an operation, an icon or a label can merge with a red site test. The release finds it after the tag. A tag cannot move.

## What to do

- Run the site tests in a gate that each PR and each push to `main` get: the quick, batch and release tiers of `cargo xtask gate` are candidates.
- Select them when the diff changes an input of a site test, for example `crates/`, `assets/ui/` or `site/`.
- Make sure that the post-merge skip rule does not skip them for a change under `site/` or `assets/`.
- Make the cut gate fail before the tag when a site test is red.
- A change of `.github/` needs the decision of the maintainer.

## Related

#3764 (`P5`) asks to run the site tests before a cut. This issue includes that work.

## Done means

A PR that makes a site test red gets a red gate. The cut gate is red for the same fault. A test pins the selection rule.
